translations.idiomatic: Tongzhou inspector Li La [10], Mingzhou inspector Dai Huang, Xinzhou inspector Qu Baishou [11], stalwart-military general Xiu Xingshi, Chenliu prefect Zhang Sui, former Angu interior administrator Que Shen, former Luling prefect Lu Zilong, former Yuning prefect Ren Mannu [12], Bashan prefect Huang Fahui, martial-display general and heir of Duke of Xiangdong Xu Jingcheng, Wu prefect Lu Guangda, former Wu prefect and founding marquis of Suixing Xiang, and credential-bearer Zhang Zhaoda, protector general and commander of the campaign, lead five thousand brocade cavalry and twenty thousand mailed men across at Shaowu and camp at Jin'an. On [10]: Li La is also written Ji La or Li Du, doubtful. On [11]: Baishou is probably Baihu (Tiger), a Tang taboo change. On [12]: Yuning, not Yuzhang, is correct here.

sentences.zh: 按轡揚旌，夷山堙谷，指期掎角，以制飛走。

translations.literal: Holding reins and raising banners, leveling mountains and filling valleys, they fix a date to pinch the corner and control those who flee.
translations.idiomatic: Holding reins and raising banners, leveling mountains and filling valleys, they set a day to pinch the corner and catch the fugitives.

sentences.zh: 前宣

translations.literal: Former Xuan
translations.idiomatic: Former Xuan

translations.literal: (wei)
translations.idiomatic: (wei)

sentences.zh: 〔城〕太守錢肅，[13]臨川太守駱牙，太子左衛率孫詡，尋陽太守莫景隆，豫章太守劉廣德，並隨機鎮遏，絡驛在路。

translations.literal: [cheng] prefect Qian Su, [13] Linchuan prefect Luo Ya, left leader of the crown prince's guard Sun Xu, Xunyang prefect Mo Jinglong, and Yuzhang prefect Liu Guangde—all according to circumstance garrison and suppress, relays on the road.
translations.idiomatic: Collation variant: [cheng]; adopted reading: Former Xuancheng prefect Qian Su [13], Linchuan prefect Luo Ya, left leader of the crown prince's guard Sun Xu, Xunyang prefect Mo Jinglong, and Yuzhang prefect Liu Guangde all garrison as occasion demands, relays on every road. On [13]: Zhou Di's biography reads Xuancheng for Xuanwei.

sentences.zh: 使持節、散騎常侍、鎮南將軍、開府儀同三司、江州刺史新建縣開國侯法𣰋，戒嚴中流，以為後殿。

translations.literal: Bearer of credentials, scattered-cavalry regular attendant, pacify-south general, opener of the mansion equal to the three dukes, Jiangzhou inspector, and founding marquis of Xinjian Fading—on alert midstream as rear guard.
translations.idiomatic: Credential-bearer Huang Fading, scattered-cavalry regular attendant, pacify-south general with a mansion equal to the three dukes, Jiangzhou inspector, and founding marquis of Xinjian, stands alert midstream as rear guard.

sentences.zh: 斧鉞所臨，罪唯元惡及留異父子。

translations.literal: Where axe and halberd reach, guilt rests only on the chief villain and Liu Yi father and son.
translations.idiomatic: Where the axe reaches, guilt rests only on the chief villain and Liu Yi and his son.

sentences.zh: 其黨主帥，雖有請泥函谷，相背淮陰，若能翻然改圖，因機立效，非止肆眚，

translations.literal: Their party chiefs, though some begged mud at Hangu and turned their backs like Huaiyin, if they can suddenly change course and by the moment establish merit, not only will amnesty be granted,
translations.idiomatic: Their chiefs, though some clung to Hangu or turned like Huaiyin, if they change course and win merit at once will not only be pardoned,

translations.literal: (nai)
translations.idiomatic: (nai)

sentences.zh: 〔仍〕加賞擢。

translations.literal: [still] with promotion and reward.
translations.idiomatic: Collation variant: [still]; adopted reading: but also be promoted and rewarded.

sentences.zh: [14]其建、晉士民，久被驅迫者，大軍明加撫慰，各安樂業，流寓失鄉，即還本土。

translations.literal: [14] The gentry and commoners of Jian and Jin long driven on—the great army will clearly comfort them; each secure in occupation; those displaced and lost to home return at once to native districts.
translations.idiomatic: [14] The people of Jian and Jin long driven by force—the great army will comfort them plainly, each to his trade; those displaced return home.

sentences.zh: 其餘立功立事，已具賞格。

translations.literal: The rest for establishing merit are already set forth in the reward scale.
translations.idiomatic: Other rewards for merit are already set out in the regulations.

sentences.zh: 若執迷不改，同惡趑趄，斧鉞一臨，罔知所赦。

translations.literal: If they cling to error and do not change, share evil and hesitate, when axe and halberd come none will know pardon.
translations.idiomatic: If they cling to error, share the crime, and hesitate, when the axe comes none will be spared.

sentences.zh: 昭達既剋周迪，踰東興嶺，頓于建安，余孝頃又自臨海道襲于晉安，寶應據建安之湖際，逆拒王師，水陸為柵。

translations.literal: Zhaoda having already taken Di crossed Dongxing Ridge and encamped at Jian'an; Yu Xiaoding also from the Linhai road struck at Jin'an; Baoying held the lake margin at Jian'an and met the royal army in opposition, setting palisades by water and land.
translations.idiomatic: Zhaoda, having beaten Di, crossed Dongxing Ridge and camped at Jian'an. Yu Xiaoding also struck Jin'an from the Linhai road. Baoying held the lake shore at Jian'an and met the royal army behind water and land palisades.

sentences.zh: 昭達深溝高壘，不與戰，但命軍士伐木為簰。

translations.literal: Zhaoda dug deep moats and high ramparts and would not fight, only ordering soldiers to cut wood for rafts.
translations.idiomatic: Zhaoda dug deep moats and high walls and would not fight, only ordering men to cut wood for rafts.

sentences.zh: 俄而水盛，乘流放之，突其水柵，仍水步薄之，寶應眾潰，身奔山草閒，窘而就執，并其子弟二十人送都，斬于建康市。

translations.literal: Soon the water rose; riding the flood they released them, burst the water palisades, and then by water and foot closed in; Baoying's host collapsed; he himself fled into mountain grass, cornered and seized, and with his sons and younger brothers twenty men was sent to the capital and beheaded in Jiankang market.
translations.idiomatic: Soon the water rose. They rode the flood, smashed the water palisades, and closed in by river and land. Baoying's army broke. He fled into the hills, was caught, and with twenty sons and younger brothers was sent to the capital and beheaded in the Jiankang market.

sentences.zh: 史臣曰：梁末之災沴，群凶競起，郡邑巖穴之長，村屯鄔壁之豪，資剽掠以致彊，恣陵侮而為大。

translations.literal: The historian says: At the end of Liang calamity and bale rose together; chiefs of commanderies and cave-holds and heroes of village stockades, relying on plunder to grow strong, indulged bullying to become great.
translations.idiomatic: The historian says: At Liang's end calamity bred rebels everywhere. Cave chiefs and stockade heroes grew strong by plunder and great by bullying.

sentences.zh: 高祖應期撥亂，戡定安輯，熊曇朗、周迪、留異、陳寶應雖身逢興運，猶志在亂常。

translations.literal: The Founder met the age, quelled disorder, and settled peace; Xiong Tanlang, Zhou Di, Liu Yi, and Chen Baoying though themselves met the rising fortune still set their hearts on disorder.
translations.idiomatic: The Founder met the age, quelled disorder, and brought peace. Xiong Tanlang, Zhou Di, Liu Yi, and Chen Baoying met the rising fortune yet still chose rebellion.

sentences.zh: 曇朗姦慝翻覆，夷滅斯為幸矣。

translations.literal: Tanlang's treachery turned again and again—his extermination was fortune indeed.
translations.idiomatic: Tanlang's treachery turned again and again; to destroy him was fortune indeed.

sentences.zh: 寶應及異，世祖或敦以婚姻，或處其類族，豈有不能威制，蓋以德懷也。

translations.literal: Baoying and Yi—Emperor Wen sometimes bound them by marriage or placed them among his kin; could he not have overawed them? It was rather that he wished to win them by virtue.
translations.idiomatic: Baoying and Yi—Emperor Wen sometimes bound them by marriage or treated them as kin. Could he not have overawed them? He meant to win them by virtue.

sentences.zh: 遂乃背恩負義，各立異圖，地匪淮南，有為帝之志，勢非庸、蜀，啟自王之心。

translations.literal: Thereupon they turned their backs on kindness and broke faith, each setting his own plan; their territory was not like Huainan, yet they harbored an emperor's ambition; their power was not like Yong and Shu, yet they awakened the heart of making themselves kings.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon they betrayed kindness and broke faith, each plotting his own course; their lands were no Huainan, yet they nursed an emperor's ambition; their strength was no Yong or Shu, yet they roused the heart of kingship.

sentences.zh: 嗚呼，既其迷暗所致，五宗屠勦，宜哉！

translations.literal: Alas! Since delusion and darkness brought it about, the slaughter and extermination of five clans—fitting indeed!
translations.idiomatic: Alas—since their own blindness brought it on, the slaughter of five clans was only fitting!

sentences.zh: 校勘記

translations.literal: Collation notes
translations.idiomatic: Collation notes

sentences.zh: 懸于朱雀觀 殿本考證云「觀」《南史》作「航」。

translations.literal: Exposed at the Vermilion Bird Tower—the Hall edition's textual verification says guan (tower) in the Southern History reads hang (landing).
translations.idiomatic: On "exposed at the Vermilion Bird Tower": the Hall edition notes tower reads landing in the Southern History.

sentences.zh: 世祖嗣位進號安南將軍 「安南將軍」

translations.literal: When Emperor Wen succeeded and was advanced to Pacify-the-South General "Pacify-the-South General"
translations.idiomatic: On "when Emperor Wen succeeded and was advanced to Pacify-the-South General"

sentences.zh: 〈世祖紀〉

translations.literal: 〈Annals of Emperor Wen〉
translations.idiomatic: 〈Annals of Emperor Wen〉

sentences.zh: 作「鎮南將軍」。

translations.literal: reads "Pacify-the-Region General."
translations.idiomatic: reads Pacify-the-Region General.

sentences.zh: 〔天嘉〕三年春 「天嘉」二字各本並脫，今據《南史》補。

translations.literal: [Tianchen] year 3 spring "Tianchen" two characters are missing in all editions; now supplied according to the Southern History.
translations.idiomatic: On "[Tianchen] year 3 spring": Tianchen is missing in all editions and is supplied per the Southern History.

sentences.zh: 寶應自海道寇臨安永嘉及會稽餘姚諸暨 洪頤煊《諸史考異》云：「『臨安』當作『臨海』。

translations.literal: Baoying from the sea route raided Lin'an, Yongjia, and Kuaiji, Yuyao, and Zhuji—Hong Yixuan's Collation of Various Histories says: "Lin'an" should be "Linhai."
translations.idiomatic: On "Baoying from the sea route raided Lin'an, Yongjia, and Kuaiji, Yuyao, and Zhuji": Hong Yixuan's Collation of Various Histories says Lin'an should be Linhai.

sentences.zh: 」按臨海與永嘉、會稽、餘姚、諸暨並在浙東，若臨安則在浙西矣。

translations.literal: Note: Linhai with Yongjia, Kuaiji, Yuyao, and Zhuji are all in eastern Zhe; if Lin'an it would be in western Zhe.
translations.idiomatic: Linhai lies with Yongjia, Kuaiji, Yuyao, and Zhuji in eastern Zhe; Lin'an would be in western Zhe.

sentences.zh: 寶應自海道來，自當先至臨海也，洪說是。

translations.literal: Baoying coming by sea would naturally reach Linhai first; Hong's view is correct.
translations.idiomatic: Baoying coming by sea would naturally strike Linhai first; Hong is right.
